==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use Blinding Surge with a preference for martial foes that are attacking. They are reluctant to use Blinding Surge on non-martial foes, preferring to use other spells if available.

== Notes ==
{{anomaly|Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except [[Sandstorm]] and [[Teinai's Wind]]), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate [[packet]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Blinding Surge/Skill history|PvE]] and [[Blinding Surge (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill histories for details.
